result.score_scope: Independent screenshot judgment, not inferred from CSS or a font name

functional_scope: Original unavailable endpoint inventory/metadata and native navigation; no live model generation or benchmark execution pass

findings.typography: Segoe UI and larger metadata improve table/field reading to8.6. Two-line filename/configured-context wrapping is readable rather than clipped.
findings.alignment: The inner ModelLab left inset differs from neighboring native screens and adds another visible alignment line.
findings.spacing: The overview has larger inner padding and a long gap/stack between tabs, summary, table and detail.
findings.information_density: Four summary counts, one selectable overview row and the same endpoint title in a boxed detail pane compete for initial viewport space; compact view reaches only the overview before scrolling.
findings.visual_hierarchy: Overview selection and selected endpoint inspection are both strongly boxed and titled; the transition needs clearer secondary emphasis rather than removing provenance.
findings.tables: Six-column original inventory remains legible at both physical sizes, including Installed/Loaded/Available/Verified context distinctions.
findings.graphs: No benchmark graph is populated in this fixture; no data/chart outcome is inferred.
findings.navigation: Original visible navigation reaches models; five local tabs are visible. Actual benchmark execution remains blocked by unavailable endpoint.
findings.empty_states: Zero recorded runs and no available endpoints are shown without invented model quality.
findings.error_states: Unknown loaded identity and unverified context stay distinct from configured context.
findings.dialogs: No ModelLab dialog screenshot is in these two pairs; dialog quality is not claimed from absent frames.
findings.text_clipping: No unintended root horizontal overflow observed; wrapped text is reachable by the original content scroll.
findings.keyboard_focus: Shared native focus/navigation evidence is available; complete ModelLab tab keyboard semantics are not inferred from styling.
findings.accessibility: Readable controls and distinct status wording; full all-control AX coverage remains separately measured.
findings.consistent_design_language: Dark rows/borders are restrained, but additional inner indentation and the repeated endpoint panel weaken consistency with other route layouts.

development_recommendation: Use the common content inset and a clearly secondary flat selected-endpoint section or disclosure. Keep every current field, table selection and configured-versus-observed context/identity distinction; do not replace errors with friendly fabricated states.
